# /plan

**Purpose:** plan the smallest unit — a task/thin slice inside a work-group.
**Inputs:** the target WG + slice.
**Files to read:** `AGENTS.md`, context-mapped files (skill `read-context`), the parent `WG-*.md`.
**Steps:**
1. Restate goal & constraints; list edge cases, risks, security concerns.
2. Propose thin-slice steps; surface trade-offs.
3. ASK before any major structural change.
**Output artifact:** task entries recorded in the WG plan (`/worklog`).
**Approval gate:** human approves the plan before coding.
**Forbidden:** starting code before approval; out-of-scope work.
